title: Sum what arrives until the pipe closes
summary: End of file on a pipe: read returns 0 when every write end is closed.
hints: The child's loop is `while (read(p[0], &x, sizeof x) == sizeof x) sum += x;`. It ends only when ALL copies of the write end are closed.
The child must close its own copy of `p[1]` (right after the `fork`) and the parent must close `p[1]` after sending: otherwise `read` never returns 0 and the child hangs.
